data.title: 妮姆芙 · 浴室水汽中的湿漉翅膀温存
data.description: 热水蒸腾的木桶浴缸中，草莓色比基尼早解开飘走。水蓝及膝长发和半透明双翼完全浸湿贴在身上，被烫得满面通红的妮姆芙紧紧跨坐在你的大腿上，随着爱意的抚摸发出甜腻柔弱的求欢。

data.action: sitting together in steamy deep bath, untied red bikini floating, wet blue twintails and translucent wings clinging to partner chest in heated embrace
data.lighting: diffused warm ceiling light shining through misty water vapor
